item.title: Letters to the News-Review: Flock Cameras in Adrian, Concerns About AI Mass Surveillance
item.description: In the age of Big Tech and artificial intelligence (AI), concerns about privacy and personal data are often front page news. Fear of mass data gathering and spying by government agencies and corporations have left many wary of new AI technologies. All of this has come to a head in Adrian MO, where citizens are deeply disturbed by the presence of Flock mass AI surveillance cameras. Cremation, with private family services and burial to take place in Pennsylvania at a later date. Arrangements entrusted to Mullinax Funeral Home, Drexel Chapel (816-657-4400). Memorial contributions may be made to the Spaulding Memorial Library, Athens, PA. Messages of condolence may be left for the family at www.mullinaxfuneralhome.com.A complete obituary is pending at this time.

item.title: Obituary - Betty Jo Christopher
item.description: Betty Jo Christopher passed away peacefully at her home in Archie, Missouri, on Tuesday, December 23, 2025, at the age of 86. A private family burial will take place at Pleasant Ridge Cemetery in Harrisonville, MO.Born on July 22, 1939, in Kansas City, MO, to William and Leona (Elston) Davis, Betty dedicated her life to family, friends, and her work as the owner of County Line Liquors in Archie, MO. Betty's heart was as vibrant as her smile, and she brought joy to everyone who crossed her path.

item.title: Thank you from The Community Food Pantry of Butler
item.description: December was another fantastic month at the Community Food Pantry of Butler! Over our 8 open days this month, we handed out 394 Christmas packages to families in need. These packages included: a ham, butter, sugar, flour, cake mix and frosting, and pie crust with pudding filling. We are so grateful to all the donors and supporters that helped make these Christmas packages a reality! Also, a big thank you to our volunteers and staff for their hard work and dedication through this holiday season!
